Yes, damaged or defective items are handled differently from standard returns. For a regular return, NOBULL accepts returns or exchanges within 30 days of delivery, except for final sale items and gift cards. Standard returns for items bought on nobullproject.com are processed through our website, while pop-up purchases must be returned at the pop-up location with the original tags, box, and receipt. For damaged or defective items, please submit a warranty claim or contact Customer Service. These items may be accepted even if worn, and you’ll need to complete a form and provide photos for review. If approved, we typically offer a replacement of the same item or store credit if it’s unavailable.
